about: Numbers tells how God's people counted their families and walked through the desert for forty years.

pages.title: Counting the People
pages.scene: God's people camped around the tabernacle
pages.text: God told Moses to count His people. There were so many! Each family camped in its own place around God's tent. When God's cloud moved, the people packed up and followed. When the cloud stopped, they stopped too.

pages.title: Twelve Spies
pages.scene: Two spies carrying a huge bunch of grapes on a pole
pages.text: Moses sent twelve men to look at the new land. It was full of good food! But ten men said, "The people there are too big. We can't win." Only Joshua and Caleb said, "God is with us. We can do it!" The people listened to the scared men, so they had to stay in the desert.
pages.lesson: Trust God instead of being afraid.

pages.title: The Bronze Snake
pages.scene: Moses holding up the bronze snake on a pole
pages.text: The people complained again. Then snakes came into the camp. The people said, "We are sorry!" God told Moses to make a snake out of bronze and put it on a pole. Anyone who looked at it got better.
pages.lesson: When we are sorry, God forgives and heals.

pages.title: The Talking Donkey
pages.scene: Balaam's donkey stopped in front of an angel
pages.text: A king paid a man named Balaam to curse God's people. On the way, an angel stood in the road. Balaam could not see it, but his donkey could! The donkey stopped, and God made it talk. In the end, Balaam blessed God's people instead.
pages.lesson: No one can curse the people God blesses.
